items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: we played with Dan since they jammed at my house for the first time in ’08

ctx.x: That’s really curious that it became apparent so quickly. Can you be specific why?

There’s just a language you build up with the people you play with for a while and we played with Dan since they jammed at my house for the first time in ’08. You know many shows earlier — I don’t know how many shows we were playing a year when Gator joined but we were upwards of 180 shows a year at one point in 2012-2013. Still a lot once Gator joined but just that much time with someone I called it the ESPN with me and Dan. You know it’s like ESP, that’s the funny name I used for it. But there is some aspect of…
Alex, do you remember if it was a big decision to quit your day gig?
